title: Crossstack quick scrub — blockers & asks (2025-07-09)
content:
Purpose: quick, ad-hoc cross-stack list for today's triage scrub (SRE / infra / product / solutions). Not exhaustive — lightweight notes + owners + next steps. Use during standup and then link to formal trackers if needed.

TABLE (columns: item | owner | priority | status | impact estimate | dependency | next step (owner + due))
1) 10k qps regression on gen model 3a | Chris Nguyen | P0 | investigating | +18% median latency, tail spiking 2x | recent kernel bump on dedicated nodes (infra/driver) + canary routing | scope kernel-change rollback and compare (Chris) — rollback attempt 07-09 10:30 PT; update by 12:00.

2) KV cache growth causing OOMs in long-chat workloads | Sophie/RAM? (Sofia Ramirez) | P1 | mitigated (temp) | 3 customers hit, ~5% requests failing | model-hosting memory config + client retries | increase client-side backpressure, patch runtime to evict stale prefixes (Ethan) — target 07-11.

3) Billing spike — unexpected usage from internal test tenant | Devon Harris | P2 | assigned | ~$6k/day overrun (est) | internal QA scripts pointed at hosted route | throttle internal keys, root-cause: runaway test job (Devon to kill job + audit logs) — done 07-09 09:15; follow-up audit 07-10.

4) Canary rollout stuck: model v2.4 stuck at 30% due to health-check flapping | Product (Lena Park) | P1 | in_progress | abort would delay release by 24h | health-checks depend on backend readiness signal (infra) | add extra readiness timeout + soft-fail metric; product to approve canary continue or rollback by 16:00.

5) Private deployment onboarding: customer A security checklist missing KMS proof | Solutions eng (Ethan Cole) | P2 | todo | blocking contract sign | security team review + sample SAML assertion (security) | Ethan to gather docs, Security to respond 07-11.

6) Observability retention exceeded for test-prod mix | Observability (Chris) | P3 | watching | extra $1200/mo if not pruned | dashboards with debug-level traces left on | prune debug traces and add auto-ttl (obs team) — plan 07-14.

QUICK ANALYSIS NOTES:
- Latency regression (item 1) is highest business risk right now: affects Hosted customers and Dedicated SLA. Early telemetry points to driver/kernel mismatch on latest optimized kernel (rev 6.1.8->6.1.10). If rollback succeeds, estimate recovery within 2–4 hours; if not, need fallback routing to other regions (costly).
- KV cache OOMs: pattern = long-chat sessions (>16k tokens) + simultaneous multi-attachment for a single session causing KV table blowup. Short-term: client-side soft limits; medium-term: runtime eviction policy and metrics.
- Billing spike was internal noise but flagged gaps: no circuit-breaker for internal automated keys. Suggest guardrail: soft quota + alert for internal tokens > X rps.

ACTIONS (who / due / notes):
- Chris N: attempt kernel rollback on canaries 07-09 10:30 PT; if rollback fails, open emergency routing (infra-runbook) — status: in-progress.
- Ethan C: sketch eviction algo and PR for runtime (RFC 1-pager) by 07-11; include test matrix for long-chat cases.
- Lena P + Product: decide canary abort or continue by 16:00 07-09; default = abort if tail > 2x baseline.
- Devon H: post-mortem for internal job run + suggest guardrail by 07-13.
- Observability: implement 30d TTL for debug traces in prod pipelines by 07-14.

RISKS & MITIGATION SUMMARY:
- If kernel rollback not allowed (binary incompatible with newer nodes), routing fallback will increase inter-region egress and instance-hours ~est +25% cost for duration — escalate to finance if >72h.
- KV cache fix delayed: more customers risk request failures; offer temporary mitigation: lower allowed max-session-length for affected tenants (customer opt-in) — Solutions to coordinate.

OPEN QUESTIONS (to bring to cross-functional sync):
- Are there any customers we must keep pinned to canary for feature gating? (Product)
- Can infra schedule a node pool that stays on earlier kernel for 72h as quarantine? (Infra)
- Who owns internal automated keys policy? (Security/Platform)

NOTES TO SELF / CHOPPY SCRIBBLE:
- Need clearer ownership on 'internal keys' — I think finance + sec should own quota but platform needs enforcement hook.
- Add quick link in Confluence once we move into formal post-mortem.
- This doc is intentionally lightweight: copy rows into JIRA epic if we need tracked tickets.

REFERENCES (quick):
- jira/INF-2387 — kernel regressions telemetry
- jira/INF-2399 — kv-cache-ooms
- github.com/redwood/inference/pull/482 — temporary client backpressure patch
- confluence/serving-runtime-daily-scrub — hub page for daily scrubs

END.
